title: Hands and Feet Grow First: Early Signs of a Growth Spurt
character: Full-body front standing pose of a friendly young guy with short brown hair, wearing a mint-green crewneck t-shirt, dark charcoal straight-leg trousers, and clean white sneakers with dark accents, standing upright with a warm confident smile, minimalist flat 2D vector character style, smooth curves, solid colors, plain white background, character design sheet style.
voice: Bright, curious, friendly, clear and brisk educational delivery with an encouraging warm cadence.

scenes.vo: Ever wondered what part of your body grows first?

figures.pose: Friendly young guy in mint-green tee looking slightly down at his hands with a curious head tilt, standing upright

scenes.vo: During a growth spurt, your hands and feet lead.

figures.pose: Character standing smiling, holding both palms up proudly and showing oversized sneakers on his feet

icons.prompt: Flat vector icon of a skin-tone hand with spread fingers, solid colors
icons.label: Hands

icons.prompt: Flat vector icon of a dark navy sneaker footprint, solid colors
icons.label: Feet

scenes.vo: They actually speed up way before your spine does.
scenes.photo: Clean 3D medical render of a human skeletal silhouette on deep royal blue background, highlighting glowing extremities in bright turquoise before the spinal column, scientific and educational.

scenes.vo: Suddenly outgrowing your shoes is a huge clue.

figures.pose: Young guy looking down wide-eyed at one foot lifted up in a tight, bursting sneaker, smiling in pleasant surprise
figures.label: New Shoes

icons.prompt: Flat vector bright orange sneaker icon popping with small sparkles
icons.label: Shoe Size

scenes.vo: Your feet usually stop growing two years earlier.

figures.pose: Character standing tall and steady while the ruler counter climbs slightly, looking confident

icons.prompt: Flat vector orange stopwatch timer with a green checkmark, solid colors
icons.label: 2 Years

scenes.vo: Still, shoe size alone won't predict final height.

figures.pose: Character shrugging playfully with hands out to sides, head tilted slightly, pleasant thoughtful expression
figures.label: Myth

icons.prompt: Flat vector red warning badge with a clean diagonal strike through a shoe silhouette
icons.label: Not exact

scenes.vo: Here's a cool trick: check your arm span.
scenes.photo: Studio photograph against a clean solid cyan background showing a teenager with arms outstretched fingertip to fingertip, holding a yellow measuring tape across the chest, crisp lighting.

scenes.vo: Fingertip to fingertip roughly matches your total height.

figures.pose: Character standing with arms spread wide in a symmetrical T-pose, big happy smile, with width and height aligned
figures.label: Equal

icons.prompt: Flat vector yellow measuring tape stretched horizontally with arrow ends, solid colors
icons.label: Arm Span

scenes.vo: So how tall will your body grow to be?

figures.pose: Character pointing forward toward the camera with one finger, leaning in friendly with an inviting grin
figures.label: Your Turn

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app. Predict your height in TallPlan.

figures.pose: Happy character giving two enthusiastic thumbs up, cheerful wide grin, relaxed stance

icons.prompt: Flat vector smartphone silhouette displaying a rising green progress chart
icons.label: TallPlan
